title: Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
brief: Researchers discovered "HalluSquatting," a vulnerability in 9 popular AI tools that allows hackers to exploit LLMs' hallucinations and refusal to admit uncertainty to assemble botnets. The technique leverages the models' tendency to generate plausible-sounding but false information, enabling attackers to create malware distribution networks at scale.
